answer: Each epoch, three established witnesses picked at random ping every seat and triangulate it from round-trip latency into a map cell, a mesa. Payouts are capped per mesa, so a farm packing 200 seats onto one rack shares a single cell's reward. Claiming a false cell fails because light cannot outrun its own delay; a seat whose timings place it in a hollow between cells is unpaid that epoch. Seats that signed the saffron canary, a fake ping no honest node answers, lose the witness role.
